verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a public web API for programmatic access to the platform: it can manage organizations, teams and other account-level resources and export data, with region-specific domains for lower latency. An official MCP server and CLI add further programmatic surfaces. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes of the common paths returned 404), detail on endpoint coverage, auth tokens and scopes, and independent hands-on confirmation of driving Sentry via the API.
